explanation: Compared against Green's Problem 68 comments: is there a blocking set B ⊆ PG(2,q) meeting every line in at least 1 and at most 1000 points? For large primes it is speculated that none exists. The statement models PG(2,p) points as Projectivization of F_p³ and lines as 2-dimensional subspaces, and asserts no such B for all large primes p. Faithful (an open speculation, tagged open).
